notes: Cross-verse split with PRO.15.4 in the placement of a supplied indefinite determiner in an anarthrous construct chain. `טוֹב־לֵב` is a construct chain whose construct the ASV renders as the attributive *cheerful* standing before the rectum's own word *heart*, with no article morpheme in the phrase and a single written determiner. Rule 29's attributive paragraph gives that determiner to the construct noun, exactly as PRO.15.4 gives the *A* of `מַרְפֵּא לָשׁוֹן` → *A gentle tongue* to `מַרְפֵּא`. The accepted unit instead read the *a* onto the rectum under rule 15, whose direction to take the noun of the expression rule 29 excludes for a construct chain. t014 therefore moves from `לֵב`'s unit into `טוֹב`'s; nothing else in the verse changes.
